panel.title: Redact
panel.empty: No pending redaction marks yet. Drag a rectangle over the page, or mark the current text selection.
panel.dragHint: Drag over the page to mark an area for redaction.

confirmDialog.whatItDoes: Redaction permanently removes the text, images, and any other content inside the marked area, then replaces it with a flat image of whatever is left behind. The content isn't hidden — it's gone.
confirmDialog.vsWhiteout: This is different from the annotate tool's opaque shape, which only paints over the content — it stays completely intact underneath, still selectable, searchable, and recoverable.
confirmDialog.wholeObjectCaveat: Redaction removes whole text runs and images that touch the marked area, not just the pixels inside it — if a mark only clips the edge of a line or picture, that entire line or picture is removed.
confirmDialog.irreversibility: You can undo this before saving, like any other edit. Once you save the file, it can't be undone.

shortcuts.markSelection: Mark the current selection for redaction

harness.title: Redact tool — manual QA harness
harness.subtitle: Development-only surface: opens the mock text document and shows the page with the redact overlay and panel, with no app shell around them.
